questions.q: Which integration runtime reaches an Azure SQL Database by default, with no extra setup?
options: No integration runtime is needed for Azure SQL Database
The Azure Integration Runtime
The SSIS integration runtime
The self-hosted integration runtime
questions.explain: Since both Data Factory and Azure SQL Database live in Azure's cloud, the default Azure Integration Runtime reaches it directly.

questions.q: What's the one real difference between configuring an Azure SQL Database linked service and an on-premises SQL Server linked service?
options: There is no difference between the two at all
On-premises SQL Server doesn't support linked services at all
Azure SQL Database requires a completely different connector gallery
Which integration runtime the connection uses — on-premises needs a self-hosted one
questions.explain: The forms look nearly identical, but on-premises SQL Server needs a self-hosted integration runtime specified under "Connect via integration runtime" — the Azure Integration Runtime alone can't reach it.

questions.q: What does a self-hosted integration runtime actually do?
options: Bridges the cloud service to on-premises data, without exposing that data directly to the internet
Automatically converts on-premises data into cloud data
Replaces the need for any linked service at all
Only works with Azure Blob Storage, not SQL Server
questions.explain: It's software installed on your own network that accepts requests from the cloud service and relays them securely to your local data store.

questions.q: What happens if you try to test the connection on a SQL Server linked service without a working self-hosted integration runtime?
options: It succeeds automatically after a short delay
Data Factory creates a self-hosted integration runtime for you automatically
The test fails every time — it isn't fixable inside the linked service form itself
It silently falls back to the Azure Integration Runtime
questions.explain: Without a working self-hosted integration runtime installed and online, the connection simply can't reach an on-premises server — the fix is installing one (Chapter 7), not adjusting the linked service settings.

questions.q: Which databases does this course's labs depend on reaching through a self-hosted integration runtime?
options: Only a cloud-hosted sample database
None — this course never connects to on-premises SQL Server
AdventureWorks2012, AdventureWorksDW2014, and Northwind
A database that doesn't require any integration runtime
questions.explain: This course's labs use the same real AdventureWorks2012, AdventureWorksDW2014, and Northwind databases the Power BI course used, hosted on the student's own SQL Server.
